items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: He told me he had a dance band in New York

ctx.x: Some of the major czars as you say, were actually pretty hip musically, weren’t they? In the early days?

Oh surely. Well a lot of them came from, some of them like Johnny Green they came from dance band experience. A lot of them did. A lot of the orchestrators. Where are you going to learn to write like that? You start with the dance band, like the great American composer William Schuman, began his life writing for dance bands. I couldn’t believe that. He told me he had a dance band in New York, for years he said, that’s why he said he was so glad to get away from saxophones. And I to this day am not a saxophone man…
